final: WITH patient_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), totals AS (SELECT SUM(examination_count) AS total_examinations, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patient_counts) SELECT p.ID, p.examination_count, 1.0 * p.examination_count / t.total_examinations AS share_of_total, 1.0 * p.examination_count / t.total_examinations - 1.0 / t.patient_count AS above_average_share FROM patient_counts p CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE 1.0 * p.examination_count > 1.0 * t.total_examinations / t.patient_count ORDER BY above_average_share DESC LIMIT 10
